prompt_text: Where should I stay in Branson Missouri, an Airbnb or a hotel, and which specific places are best?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: it depends on what you want from the trip. For convenience, shows, and predictable service, pick a hotel on/near the 76 “Strip.” For more space, a kitchen, better value for families, or a lake/cabin experience, pick an Airbnb (or a condo/resort rental). If you tell me dates, party size, and priorities I can suggest exact current listings — below are guidelines and specific, reliable options to consider.

How to choose (quick decision guide)
- If you want to be within walking distance of theaters, restaurants and nightlife: hotel on the 76 Strip (better concierge/ticket help, daily housekeeping).
- If you want a private cabin, meals, a hot tub, dock access, or lots of space for a family group: Airbnb/cabin on Table Rock Lake or near Silver Dollar City.
- If you want resort amenities (spa, pools, on-site activities): choose a resort hotel (Big Cedar Lodge, Chateau-style resorts).
- If you want the cheapest short stay with no cooking/cleaning responsibility: mid-range chain hotel.
- If you’re coming for an event/convention: book a hotel near the Branson Convention Center.

Recommended hotels (good for convenience, service, shows)
- Big Cedar Lodge — top pick for a resort/lakeside experience and outdoor activities. Good for families and couples wanting a full-resort stay.
- Chateau on the Lake (resort & spa) — upscale, scenic, nice for a romantic or pampered stay.
- Hilton Branson Convention Center — convenient for shows and centrally located on/near the Strip; easy access to theaters.
- Drury Plaza / Drury Inn & Suites Branson area — consistently good value, often includes breakfast and evening snacks.
- Welk Resort Branson / Westgate-style condo resorts — good for families who want condo-style units and on-site amenities.

Types of Airbnbs to look for (what to search)
- Lakefront/near-dock cabin on Table Rock Lake (Hollister, Indian Point, Ridgedale) — great for boating, fishing, private outdoor time.
- Cozy Ozark log cabin with hot tub — romantic or relaxing family option.
- Condo/apartment on or near the 76 Strip — combine Airbnb privacy with short walk to shows.
- Large family house in Branson/Hollister — economical for groups (multiple bedrooms, kitchen, family room).

Neighborhoods and what they’re good for
- 76 “Strip” (Hwy 76/Country Blvd): best for shows, restaurants, easy walking, tourist energy.
- Table Rock Lake / Indian Point / Hollister / Ridgedale: lake activities, quiet cabins, scenic views.
- Near Silver Dollar City / Branson West / Point Lookout: good for theme-park families and shorter drives to outdoor attractions.
- Downtown/Branson Landing area: shopping and lakeside dining (if that fits your plan).

Practical tips for picking between Airbnb and hotel
- Check total price (cleaning fee + service + taxes) for Airbnbs — not just nightly rate.
- For an Airbnb, prefer “Superhost” and read recent reviews for cleanliness, accuracy, and host responsiveness.
- For shows and dinner plans, factor in traffic/parking and travel time from a cabin to the Strip (many lake cabins are 15–30 min drive).
- If you need late check-in, consistent linens, or 24/7 front desk help, a hotel is easier.
- If you have pets, filter for pet-friendly listings or choose a pet-friendly hotel (fewer options than Airbnb).
- Watch cancellation policies — hotels usually have flexible refundable rates; many Airbnbs are stricter.

Budget guidance (rough)
- Budget hotels / motels: typically lower nightly rates ($80–150 depending on season).
- Midrange hotels and condos: $120–250.
- Resort lodges, lakefront cabins, larger Airbnbs: $200–500+ depending on size/season/amenities.

If you want, I can:
- Suggest specific current hotel or Airbnb listings for your exact dates and number of people.
- Narrow choices by budget, pet needs, or whether you want lake access, hot tub, or proximity to specific shows.

What are your dates, party size, budget, and top priorities (lake vs shows vs convenience)? I’ll pull tailored suggestions.
